name: Power Sum Disguise
description: Replaces the sum of squares of counts condition with a sum of powers of 2. Summing k powers of 2 (each at most 2^(k-1)) can only yield 2^k - 1 if all powers are distinct, enforcing the 3DM constraint. Models that implement the sum literally without mathematically deducing distinctness will suffer weak pruning (as small duplicates sum slowly) and TLE.
